About Hartwell & Co.

An independent agency built on trust, local knowledge and long-term relationships.

Our story

Eleanor Hartwell opened our first office in Beverly Hills in 2008 with one belief: buying a home should feel like a partnership, not a transaction.

Today our team of 25 advisors has helped more than 950 families move, with most clients returning or referring friends.

🎯

Our mission

To make every property decision clear, confident and stress-free through honest advice and hands-on service.

🔭

Our vision

To be the most trusted name in Southern California real estate, measured by the clients who come back.
